title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
abstract: arXiv:2608.16029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. translated_title: 组独立成分分析2.0：通过Copula链接的组ICA（CoLiG-ICA）弥合受试者与组潜变量分解之间的差距
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16029v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：组独立成分分析（gICA）广泛用于将高维功能磁共振成像数据分解为可解释的脑网络。然而，传统gICA主要识别受试者间共享的成分。这种组级假设可能限制仅存在于个体或受试者子集中的网络的恢复，从而降低对临床神经影像数据中受试者间异质性的敏感性。我们引入了Copula链接的组ICA（CoLiG-ICA），这是一种在Group ICA 2.0框架中的算法，它在统一模型中联合估计模板链接、队列专属和受试者专属的脑网络。CoLiG-ICA结合了基于ICA的空间分解、基于Copula的依赖建模和深度学习优化，以保持模板约束ICA的一致性和可解释性，同时允许参考网络之外的自由成分。通过将受试者分解链接到共享模板并联合估计，该算法增强了异质性检测能力。
tldr: CoLiG-ICA通过结合Copula依赖建模和深度学习优化，在统一框架中联合估计共享、队列专属和个体专属脑网络，显著提升了对受试者间异质性的敏感性，弥合了传统组ICA的局限性。
en_tdlr: CoLiG-ICA integrates copula-based dependence modeling and deep learning optimization to jointly estimate shared, cohort-specific, and subject-specific brain networks in a unified framework, significantly enhancing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity and overcoming limitations of conventional group ICA.
